# chainlaunch_metrics_prometheus (Resource)

Deploys and manages a Prometheus monitoring instance for Chainlaunch nodes.

## Example Usage

### Basic

```terraform
resource "chainlaunch_metrics_prometheus" "default" {
  version         = "v2.45.0"
  port            = 9090
  scrape_interval = 15
  deployment_mode = "docker"
  network_mode    = "bridge"
}
```

### With TSDB retention

```terraform
resource "chainlaunch_metrics_prometheus" "with_retention" {
  scrape_interval = 15

  # Keep 90 days of data, capped at 50GB of disk (applied on next start/restart)
  retention_time = "90d"
  retention_size = "50GB"
}
```

### Shipping metrics to an external store with remote_write

```terraform
resource "chainlaunch_metrics_prometheus" "external_obs" {
  scrape_interval = 15
  retention_time  = "30d"

  # Ship metrics to Grafana Cloud (or Thanos / Mimir / Cortex)
  remote_write = [
    {
      url  = "https://prometheus-prod.grafana.net/api/prom/push"
      name = "grafana-cloud"
      basic_auth = {
        username = "123456"
        password = var.grafana_cloud_api_key
      }
    },
    {
      url = "https://thanos.internal.example.com/api/v1/receive"
      tls = {
        ca_file     = "/etc/prometheus/certs/ca.pem"
        server_name = "thanos.internal.example.com"
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `deployment_mode` (String) Deployment mode: docker or binary (default: docker)
- `network_mode` (String) Docker network mode: bridge or host (default: bridge)
- `port` (Number) Port for Prometheus server (default: 9090)
- `remote_write` (Attributes List) Prometheus remote_write endpoints used to ship metrics to an external long-term store (e.g. Grafana Cloud, Thanos, Mimir). Empty (default) renders no remote_write block. Credentials (basic_auth password, bearer_token) are write-only and never read back from the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remote_write))
- `retention_size` (String) TSDB size-based retention passed to --storage.tsdb.retention.size (e.g. "50GB", "512MB"). Empty (default) enforces no size-based limit. Applied on the next start/restart.
- `retention_time` (String) TSDB time-based retention passed to --storage.tsdb.retention.time (e.g. "30d", "90d"). Empty (default) leaves Prometheus at its implicit 15d retention. Applied on the next start/restart.
- `scrape_interval` (Number) Scrape interval in seconds (default: 15)
- `version` (String) Prometheus version to deploy (default: v2.45.0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (always 'prometheus' as only one instance is supported)
- `started_at` (String) Timestamp when Prometheus was started
- `status` (String) Current status of Prometheus instance

<a id="nestedatt--remote_write"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remote_write`

Required:

- `url` (String) The remote_write endpoint URL (e.g. https://prometheus-prod.grafana.net/api/prom/push)

Optional:

- `basic_auth` (Attributes) HTTP basic-auth credentials for the remote_write endpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remote_write--basic_auth))
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for authenticating to the remote_write endpoint (write-only, never returned by the API)
- `name` (String) Optional name for the remote_write endpoint
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS configuration for the remote_write endpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remote_write--tls))

<a id="nestedatt--remote_write--basic_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remote_write.basic_auth`

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Basic-auth password (write-only, never returned by the API)
- `username` (String) Basic-auth username

<a id="nestedatt--remote_write--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remote_write.tls`

Optional:

- `ca_file` (String) Path to the CA certificate file (inside the Prometheus container/host)
- `cert_file` (String) Path to the client certificate file
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Disable validation of the remote_write server certificate
- `key_file` (String) Path to the client key file
- `server_name` (String) ServerName used to verify the hostname on the returned certificate

## Usage Notes

- **No forced replacement**: All new attributes (`retention_time`, `retention_size`, `remote_write`) are Optional + Computed with provider defaults. Existing state created before these attributes existed shows no forced replacement and no perpetual diff.
- **Retention is a launch flag**: `retention_time` and `retention_size` map to the `--storage.tsdb.retention.time` / `--storage.tsdb.retention.size` Prometheus launch flags. Changing them stops and redeploys the instance so they take effect.
- **Write-only credentials**: `remote_write[*].bearer_token` and `remote_write[*].basic_auth.password` are sent to the API on deploy but are never returned. The provider preserves them in state from your configuration; the API never echoes them back.
- **External long-term storage**: `remote_write` lets ChainLaunch's bundled Prometheus forward metrics to Grafana Cloud, Thanos, Mimir, Cortex, or any remote_write-compatible receiver.
